critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py negotiation_gap_report: passes through vehicle_type as-is (e.g. 'sb' slug) — UI shows a capitalize() but humans would prefer display names (name_fr). Consider joining vehicle_types collection or mapping slug->name_fr server-side so the bar chart x-axis and table vehicule column are readable.

routes/admin.py: the `days` query param is unbounded. A request with days=3650 would scan up to 5000 rides and build full dicts in memory. Clamp to a sane max (e.g. max(1, min(days, 365))) and/or add an index on rides.created_at.

routes/admin.py: `samples` is truncated to the first 20 rides iterated, which is arrival order from mongo (not 'recent'). Contract says 'max 20 recent rides' — either sort rides by created_at desc before the loop or keep all samples and slice last 20 by date.

routes/admin.py avg_gap_pct averages percentages (mean of per-ride pct) rather than weighting by proposed amount. For tariff calibration the weighted gap (total_gap/total_proposed*100) is usually more meaningful — consider adding weighted_avg_gap_pct alongside.

AdminNegotiationGapReport.js fetch call ignores 401 (just toasts 'Erreur de chargement') — on expired session user sees only a toast with no redirect to /admin-login. Use the axios admin client (with the refresh interceptor) instead of raw fetch, consistent with other admin pages.
AdminNegotiationGapReport.js: `report.total_revenue_gap.toFixed(2)` will throw if backend returns undefined. Guard with `(report.total_revenue_gap ?? 0).toFixed(2)` for resilience.

Zone inference is substring-based and case-sensitive on the lowercased address only; addresses like '75001 Paris, France' match correctly but 'Paris 15e' before a comma still lands in the fallback last-segment branch if the token 'paris' isn't caught (it IS caught here). Consider backing with an explicit insee_city field when available to avoid collisions (e.g. a street named 'Paris' in another city).

Only counts rides with status in {accepted,arriving,in_progress,completed} AND proposed_fare>0. accepted fare preference: final_fare > estimated_fare. Zone inference tokens (lowercase): martinique/fort-de-france -> Martinique; guadeloupe/pointe-a-pitre -> Guadeloupe; guyane; reunion; paris; lyon; marseille; fallback last comma segment truncated to 30 chars ('Inconnue' if empty). To seed more rides for chart variety use: create ride via POST /api/rides with proposed_fare=X, then driver POST /api/rides/{id}/counter-offer {amount: Y}, then passenger POST /api/rides/{id}/accept-offer/{offer_id}.
